title: Decision-conditioned complete-lease joint-error Bayesian fusion development extension
evidence_scope: Known four physical traces are development replays; no new independent evidence claimed.
prior: Total concentration 2, symmetric residual atoms ±0.1 sqrt(m_total) e_s, zero mean and covariance .01 I; weak regularizing prior, not observed outcomes. Current source mask restricts the full prior.
posterior: Every mature lease stores immutable source origin probabilities and origin x, and complete-lease x/y/common-serving mask. At CURRENT gate, the CURRENT candidate/reference contrast projects both origin probabilities and complete past lease labels. E_current=origin source forecast under current contrast−actual past common-served gross contrast/current origin N. Full joint blocks retained; no future label used before complete maturity.
objective: −wᵀ(h−mu)+tau KL(w||pi)+lambda/2 wᵀ(Σ/r)w+kappa_weight sqrt(wᵀUraw w+.01²); full kappa_weight1, others0; diagonal takes diagonal Σ,U.
gate: f−5−q sΣ > margin, f=N[wᵀ(h−mu)−kappa_forecast sqrt(wᵀUraw w+.01²)], sΣ=N sqrt(wᵀΣw+.0001). full and bound-only kappa_forecast1; other arms0. Point gate uses q=0 in action. Σ=B because one immutable reprojected residual vector is a complete-lease atom; joint predictive calibrated gate is identical to empirical block calibrated gate.
selection: fit initial quantile from matured first-half calibration origins; maximize second-half mean actual net, then smaller margin/lambda; no test retuning
methodology_history: A first calibration-only origin-contrast prototype was preserved, then corrected to current-decision re-projection before any enhanced test output.
algorithm_history: Two calibration-only prototypes preserved (origincontrast archive, reprojected U gate). Before any enhanced/newtask test execution, current-decision reprojection with predictiveΣ gate and explicit posterior robustmean was frozen.
